tool_args.rationale: The five pilot observations do not distinguish plausible substrate and sink mechanisms. The open-branch discriminating probe directly addresses this identifiability ambiguity at lower cost than the trajectory batch.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary smooth model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The inputs vary together, leaving the substrate response and gradient-dependent sink confounded; the recalled mechanisms do not uniquely identify the law.
The immediate ambiguity concerns the open-branch input dependence, not trajectory resolution, and this probe costs more.
It is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
